relationships.subject: peripheral nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: protein synthesis was upregulated in spinal microglia on day 4 but not on day 14 after peripheral nerve injury

relationships.subject: 4E-BP1
relationships.evidence_quote: which repress translation by binding and inhibiting the activity of the mRNA 5′ cap-binding protein eIF4E

relationships.subject: microglial 4E-BP1 ablation
relationships.evidence_quote: Behavioral analysis revealed that adult male and female 4E-BP1–cKO mice exhibited mechanical hypersensitivity in von Frey

relationships.subject: mutant 4E-BP1 in microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: mechanical hypersensitivity induced by peripheral nerve injury was substantially alleviated in 4E-BP1 cMT compared with control animals

relationships.subject: mTORC1
relationships.evidence_quote: mTORC1 stimulates translation predominantly by phosphorylating eukaryotic initiation factor (eIF) 4E-binding proteins (4E-BPs)

key_findings: Nerve injury upregulates microglial protein synthesis at day 4; 4E-BP1 ablation in microglia induces reactive state and mechanical hypersensitivity in both sexes.
Inhibiting microglial translation before but not after injury alleviates neuropathic pain, implicating translation in development not maintenance.
